body.purpose: Compact, readable site controls and result data.

display.purpose: Existing semantic headings only; Filelist controls their hierarchy.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Amber is reserved for Filelist's browse submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--fl-amber); color: #241b10; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid #d69e4e; border-radius: 7px; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--fl-amber-bright); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fl-amber-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Utility and reset actions remain quiet against the surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--fl-raised); color: var(--fl-text); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--fl-border); border-radius: 7px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--fl-hover); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fl-amber-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: The query field expands before the native filter controls wrap.
components.css: .ds-input-search { background: var(--fl-canvas); color: var(--fl-text); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--fl-border); border-radius: 7px; font: inherit; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--fl-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fl-amber-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: The site's navigation keeps its labels and gains a quiet dark surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--fl-surface); border: 1px solid var(--fl-border); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--fl-text); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--fl-amber-bright); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fl-amber-bright); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Result row
components.description: Quiet separators and tabular figures keep dense result metadata scannable.
components.css: .ds-result-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fl-border); color: var(--fl-text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result-row:hover { background: var(--fl-hover); }

narrative.overview: Filelist is a dense, task-focused site. Night Archive gives it a quiet reading surface: charcoal panels, warm paper text, and amber wayfinding. The site's content, links, and existing actions remain recognizable.
keyCharacteristics: Amber highlights only the browse action, links, and keyboard focus.
Dense result data uses clear row separators and tabular numerals.
Serif headings add a restrained editorial note; the interface stays compact.
No external assets or motion are needed to carry the visual identity.

rules.name: The Preserve-Native-Behavior Rule
rules.body: Preserve Filelist's existing links, forms, and labels.

rules.name: The No-External-Requests Rule
rules.body: Keep scripts, remote assets, analytics, and automatic requests out of this UserCSS.

dos: Do preserve native Filelist links, forms, and labels.
Do keep focus visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do scope future script-based features separately and make them opt in.
donts: Don't add JavaScript, remote fonts, images, analytics, or automatic requests to this UserCSS.
Don't use CSS-generated text as a substitute for working controls.
Don't style every site action as a primary action.
